<span id="_text_formatting_&_inline_elements"></span>
= Text Formatting &amp; Inline Elements =

<span id="_basic_styles"></span>
== Basic Styles ==

* '''Bold Text''' ('''<code>Bold</code> <code>Text</code>''')
* ''Italic Text'' (''<code>Italic</code> <code>Text</code>'')
* <code>Monospaced</code> <code>Code</code> (<code>Monospaced</code> <code>Code</code>)
* '''<code>Bold</code> <code>Monospaced</code>''' (`*<code>Bold</code> <code>Monospaced</code>*`)
* ''<code>Italic</code> <code>Monospaced</code>'' (`_<code>Italic</code> <code>Monospaced</code>_`)

<span id="_advanced_inline_formatting"></span>
== Advanced Inline Formatting ==

* <span class="underline">Underlined Text</span> (<span class="underline"><code>Underlined</code> <code>Text</code></span>)
* <span class="line-through">Strikethrough Text</span> (<span class="line-through"><code>Strikethrough</code> <code>Text</code></span>)
* <span class="mark">Highlighted Text</span> (<span class="mark"><code>Highlighted</code> <code>Text</code></span>)
* Superscript: E = mc<sup>2</sup> (<code>E</code> <code>=</code> <code>mc</code><sup><code>2</code></sup>)
* Subscript: H<sub>2</sub>O (<code>H</code><sub><code>2</code></sub><code>O</code>)
* Smart symbols: © ® ™ — → ← ⇒ ⇐

<span id="_description_list_(glossary)"></span>
== Description List (Glossary) ==

; Node.js
: A JavaScript runtime built on Chrome’s V8 JavaScript engine.
; AsciiDoc
: A human-readable document format for writing technical documentation.
; AST
: Abstract Syntax Tree, a tree representation for the abstract syntactic structure of source code.

<span id="_code_blocks_callouts"></span>
= Code Blocks &amp; Callouts =

<span id="_standard_code_block_with_syntax_highlighting"></span>
== Standard Code Block with Syntax Highlighting ==

<syntaxhighlight lang="typescript">import { parseAsciiDoc } from 'adoc-converter';

interface ParseOptions {
  standalone?: boolean;
  safeMode?: 'unsafe' | 'safe' | 'server' | 'secure';
}

export async function processFile(filePath: string, options: ParseOptions = {}): Promise<string> {
  console.log(`Processing file: ${filePath}`);
  return parseAsciiDoc(filePath, options);
}</syntaxhighlight>
<span id="_code_block_with_callouts"></span>
== Code Block with Callouts ==

<syntaxhighlight lang="javascript">const fs = require('fs');
const adoc = require('adoc-converter'); // ①

const content = fs.readFileSync('doc.adoc', 'utf8'); // ②
const html = adoc.convert(content); // ③

console.log(html); // ④</syntaxhighlight>
<div class="callout-list">
# Import the Node.js AsciiDoc converter module.
# Read the raw <code>.adoc</code> source file from the disk.
# Convert the AsciiDoc string into an HTML string.
# Print the rendered output to stdout.

</div>

<span id="_abstract_block"></span>
= Abstract Block =

This document serves as an exhaustive test fixture for evaluating AsciiDoc converters written for or compiled to Node.js (such as <code>@asciidoctor/core</code>, <code>asciidoctor.js</code>, or custom AST-based parsers).
